# Microsoft Azure Billing management client library for .NET

Microsoft Cost Management is a suite of tools that help organizations monitor, allocate, and optimize the cost of their Microsoft Cloud workloads.

This library supports viewing and managing your billing details.

This library follows the [new Azure SDK guidelines](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/general_introduction.html), and provides many core capabilities:

    - Support MSAL.NET, Azure.Identity is out of box for supporting MSAL.NET.
    - Support [OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/) for distributed tracing.
    - HTTP pipeline with custom policies.
    - Better error-handling.
    - Support uniform telemetry across all languages.

## Getting started 

### Install the package

Install the Microsoft Azure Billing management library for .NET with [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/):

```dotnetcli
dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.Billing
```

### Prerequisites

* You must have an [Microsoft Azure subscription](https://azure.microsoft.com/free/dotnet/).

### Authenticate the Client

To create an authenticated client and start interacting with Microsoft Azure resources, see the [quickstart guide here](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).

## Key concepts

Key concepts of the Microsoft Azure SDK for .NET can be found [here](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/dotnet_introduction.html).

## Documentation

Documentation is available to help you learn how to use this package:

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/doc/dev/mgmt_quickstart.md).
- [API References](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/?view=azure-dotnet).
- [Authentication](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/blob/main/sdk/identity/Azure.Identity/README.md).

## Examples

Code samples for using the management library for .NET can be found in the following locations
- [.NET Management Library Code Samples](https://aka.ms/azuresdk-net-mgmt-samples)

## Troubleshooting

-   File an issue via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-net/issues).
-   Check [previous questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/azure+.net) or ask new ones on Stack Overflow using Azure and .NET tags.

## Next steps

For more information about Microsoft Azure SDK, see [this website](https://azure.github.io/azure-sdk/).

## Contributing

For details on contributing to this repository, see the [contributing
guide][cg].

This project welcomes contributions and suggestions. Most contributions
require you to agree to a Contributor License Agreement (CLA) declaring
that you have the right to, and actually do, grant us the rights to use
your contribution. For details, visit <https://cla.microsoft.com>.

When you submit a pull request, a CLA-bot will automatically determine
whether you need to provide a CLA and decorate the PR appropriately
(for example, label, comment). Follow the instructions provided by the
bot. You'll only need to do this action once across all repositories
using our CLA.

This project has adopted the [Microsoft Open Source Code of Conduct][coc]. For
more information, see the [Code of Conduct FAQ][coc_faq] or contact
<opencode@microsoft.com> with any other questions or comments.

proposals.subtype: Billing account options unpacked into list arguments
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetAll sync/async overloads unpack nullable options into include flags, owner identifiers, expand/filter/search/skip and maxCount mapped from Top, forwarding cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit hidden forwarding bodies are in src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Account policy Update aliases CreateOrUpdate
proposals.explanation: The hidden Update sync/async pair forwards WaitUntil, BillingAccountPolicyData and cancellation to CreateOrUpdate, without implementing polling or tag logic itself.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: These concrete alias bodies are supplied in a non-generated Custom partial resource.

proposals.subtype: Account billing-request overloads unpack an options aggregate
proposals.explanation: GetBillingRequests sync/async overloads call GetByBillingAccount with nullable Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search values.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual options-decomposition calls are captured under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Account reservation overloads adapt an options aggregate
proposals.explanation: GetReservations sync/async overloads call GetByBillingAccount with Filter, OrderBy, Skiptoken, RefreshSummary, SelectedState and Take in that positional order, plus cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both forwarding bodies are implemented in non-generated Custom resource source.

proposals.subtype: Suppressed action replacements invoke a DateTimeOffset content helper
proposals.explanation: CancelPaymentTerms sync/async replacements pass the DateTimeOffset through BillingRequestContentHelper.ToRequestContent into the REST request, send it, construct a typed BillingArmOperation using Location final-state selection and wait only for WaitUntil.Completed. The helper's actual JSON encoding is not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: CodeGenSuppress targets both signatures and complete replacement bodies under src/Custom show the explicit payload-helper call.

proposals.subtype: Savings plan options forwarded to account-scoped list methods
proposals.explanation: GetByBillingAccountSavingsPlan sync/async overloads unpack Filter, OrderBy, Skiptoken, Take, SelectedState and RefreshSummary and call GetByBillingAccount in that positional order.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit hidden compatibility overloads are captured outside Generated in src/Custom.

proposals.subtype: Associated-tenant options mapped to named list parameters
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetAll pair null-conditionally unpacks Count, Filter, IncludeRevoked, OrderBy, Search, Skip and Top-to-maxCount and forwards cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The captured Custom collection supplies both argument-adaptation bodies.

proposals.subtype: Customer list options unpacked into query arguments
proposals.explanation: GetAll sync/async overloads map nullable Expand, Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search into named arguments of other list overloads.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Concrete hidden forwarding bodies occur under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Customer policy Update aliases CreateOrUpdate
proposals.explanation: Hidden Update and UpdateAsync methods forward WaitUntil, BillingCustomerPolicyData and cancellation to their CreateOrUpdate counterparts.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-generated Custom partial contains the explicit alias implementations.

proposals.subtype: Customer subscription-list options forwarded under a scope-qualified name
proposals.explanation: GetBillingSubscriptionsByCustomerAtBillingAccount sync/async overloads call GetByCustomerAtBillingAccount with nullable IncludeDeleted, Expand, Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Actual scope-renaming and options-unpacking calls are supplied in non-generated Custom source.

proposals.subtype: Customer product-list options forwarded to GetByCustomer
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetProducts sync/async overloads null-conditionally unpack Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search and delegate to GetByCustomer.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual forwarding implementations are captured under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Department enrollment accounts accept aggregate query options
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetAll pair forwards nullable Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search to named list arguments along with cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The concrete argument-mapping bodies are in a non-generated Custom collection.

proposals.subtype: Enrollment account options unpacked for list calls
proposals.explanation: GetAll and GetAllAsync adapt a nullable BillingEnrollmentAccountCollectionGetAllOptions into Filter, OrderBy, maxCount from Top, Skip, Count and Search query arguments.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Explicit hidden overload bodies are captured under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Enrollment subscription options forwarded to GetByEnrollmentAccount
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetBillingSubscriptions pair null-conditionally unpacks Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search and delegates to GetByEnrollmentAccount methods.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The scope-qualified forwarding bodies are in supplied non-generated Custom source.

proposals.subtype: Invoice list options rename date and count arguments
proposals.explanation: The hidden invoice GetAll pair maps PeriodStartDate to periodStartsOn, PeriodEndDate to periodEndsOn and Top to maxCount while forwarding filter/order/skip/count/search and cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both concrete options adapters are captured in src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Invoice transaction options forwarded to GetByInvoice
proposals.explanation: The GetTransactions sync/async overloads map nullable Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search to the scope-qualified GetByInvoice methods.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual hidden forwarding overloads are non-generated Custom resource source.

proposals.subtype: Invoice-section list options unpack include-deleted and query fields
proposals.explanation: The hidden GetAll pair maps nullable Count, Filter, IncludeDeleted, OrderBy, Search, Skip and Top-to-maxCount to other list overloads.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The concrete options-mapping bodies are supplied under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Invoice-section billing-request options forwarded under a scoped name
proposals.explanation: GetBillingRequests and GetBillingRequestsAsync call GetByInvoiceSection with nullable Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count, Search and cancellation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom partial resource implements both hidden adapters outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Invoice-section subscription options unpacked positionally
proposals.explanation: GetBillingSubscriptions sync/async overloads call GetByInvoiceSection with IncludeDeleted, Expand, Filter, OrderBy, Top, Skip, Count and Search in that order using null-conditional reads.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both explicit positional adapters are captured in non-generated Custom source.

proposals.subtype: Invoice-section product options decomposed into named arguments
proposals.explanation: GetProducts sync/async overloads delegate to same-named overloads using nullable Filter, OrderBy, Top-to-maxCount, Skip, Count and Search arguments.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The actual overload-forwarding bodies are supplied in src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Invoice-section transaction options forwarded with direct property reads
proposals.explanation: GetTransactions sync/async overloads directly dereference options.PeriodStartDate, PeriodEndDate, Type and query fields before calling GetByInvoiceSection; unlike other captured adapters, they do not use null-conditional reads or an explicit null guard.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full property-unpacking bodies are captured under src/Custom outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Hidden deletion operation reconstructs a version-pinned HTTP request
proposals.explanation: Delete sync/async methods construct a DELETE paymentMethodLinks request with escaped resource names, api-version 2021-10-01 and JSON Accept, send it, create a DELETE rehydration token using the Location header/final-state choice, wrap the response in BillingArmOperation and wait conditionally. Failures are recorded and rethrown.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The non-generated Custom resource includes complete hidden operation bodies plus a literal HTTP request builder; this is not merely generated LRO behavior.

decisions.reason: The non-generated Custom partial contains both hidden GetAll overloads and maps the options properties, including Top to maxCount, into the other overloads at the cited lines. This is a reusable, plausibly generator-producible compatibility adapter, not custom pagination.

The Custom partial implements hidden Update/UpdateAsync aliases that directly forward to CreateOrUpdate/Async. The file comment identifies both legacy API compatibility and a tag-helper motivation; the cited bodies do not implement their own LRO.
Both hidden billing-request overloads visibly unpack nullable option properties and delegate to GetByBillingAccount/Async in the cited non-generated Custom source.

The cited Custom methods forward the six listed nullable reservation options positionally to GetByBillingAccount/Async, preserving an options-based public overload rather than changing page iteration.

CodeGenSuppress identifies the replaced signatures, and both handwritten implementations visibly pass the DateTimeOffset through BillingRequestContentHelper.ToRequestContent before sending and creating typed operations. Serialization is the relevant purpose of this primitive-body adapter; the helper implementation and its actual JSON wire representation are not captured.

The two cited hidden overloads in the Custom partial forward the six nullable savings-plan options to GetByBillingAccount/Async in exactly the stated order. Their distinct method pair is one compatibility adapter.

The cited handwritten GetAll pair maps the seven nullable associated-tenant options to named arguments and forwards cancellation; the proposal describes this one adapter without claiming a custom pager.
The hidden GetAll/Async bodies in the Custom partial map each stated customer-list option, including Top to maxCount, into their other overloads.

The cited non-generated methods implement the distinct customer-policy Update/Async aliases by forwarding directly to CreateOrUpdate/Async. The comment's tag-helper and compatibility motivations are not presented as separate behaviors.
The two cited Custom overloads retain the scope-qualified billing-subscription method name and unpack all stated nullable option fields into GetByCustomerAtBillingAccount/Async.
The Custom GetProducts/Async option overloads visibly map six nullable properties to GetByCustomer/Async; this is a separate customer-product compatibility adapter.
The hidden department-enrollment GetAll pair in Custom forwards the six specified nullable option fields as named parameters, including Top to maxCount.
Both handwritten enrollment-account collection overloads unpack the specified nullable query options into other GetAll/Async overloads at the cited lines.
The non-generated resource retains GetBillingSubscriptions/Async options overloads and forwards the six nullable query values to GetByEnrollmentAccount/Async.
The hidden invoice-list pair in Custom maps the date properties to periodStartsOn/periodEndsOn, Top to maxCount, and the remaining cited query properties as described.
The captured invoice-resource GetTransactions/Async overloads unpack nullable options into GetByInvoice/Async with the stated Top-to-maxCount mapping.
The invoice-section collection's Custom GetAll/Async pair forwards Count, Filter, IncludeDeleted, OrderBy, Search, Skip and Top-to-maxCount from the options model.
The hidden billing-request pair in the Custom invoice-section resource forwards nullable query options under the generated GetByInvoiceSection/Async name at the cited lines.
The cited Custom billing-subscription overloads positionally forward the eight stated nullable options to GetByInvoiceSection/Async; no page traversal is implemented here.
The Custom invoice-section GetProducts/Async option overloads forward six nullable fields as named arguments to other same-named overloads at the cited lines.

Unlike the other captured adapters, both invoice-section GetTransactions overloads directly access options properties without null-conditional reads and forward date, type and query values to GetByInvoiceSection/Async, exactly as stated.

The core handwritten customization is restoring a hidden legacy DELETE operation with a manually assembled version-pinned request; the LRO wrapper is part of that operation, not evidence of a customized poller. Other better captures the purpose than LRO / polling. The captured AppendPath calls take a true flag for variable names, but the escaping implementation itself is not supplied.

finding.subtype: Legacy delete operation with manually assembled version-pinned request
finding.explanation: Hidden Delete/Async methods manually send a DELETE request assembled from resource-name path segments and api-version 2021-10-01, create a Location-based rehydration token and BillingArmOperation, and wait only when requested; the captured file says the operation was retained for legacy callers after removal from the newer TypeSpec.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The non-generated Custom partial contains the complete hidden operation bodies and a literal HTTP request builder, rather than only a generated LRO poller.

limitations: Fifteen of 1023 eligible files were captured, with fifty-eight skipped paths. No exhaustive discovery, package-wide absence or runtime correctness is claimed.

The primitive payload helper, generated overloads, options models and LRO polling implementations are not supplied. The caller's conversion-helper invocation is visible, but JSON encoding details, positional target signatures and compilation/generation success are not independently established.
Comments describing generator bugs, tag-helper compilation failures, GA compatibility and dropped operations are context only; neither linked issues nor historical APIs were inspected.

Options adapters are convenience API mappings, not separately inferred pager implementations. The transaction-options direct dereference differs visibly from neighboring null-conditional adapters; no SDK fix was made.

The hardcoded 2021-10-01 deletion request and Location rehydration construction are measured source facts, not proof the endpoint still works or that current generation can support its compatibility contract.
Project version 1.3.0-beta.1 differs from latest-release metadata 1.2.2; the source version does not establish publication.

Coverage is partial: 15 of 1023 eligible source files are captured (1124 discovered), with the listed Custom files skipped by the review budget. The 22 decisions describe only supplied snippets; they do not establish package-wide completeness or absence of further customizations.

Generated counterparts, prior released API, the referenced BillingRequestContentHelper implementation and TypeSpec definitions are not captured. File comments explain intended compatibility and workaround motivations, but cannot independently establish the exact prior API, actual primitive JSON encoding or current generator capabilities.

The delete shim's URI builder implementation is not supplied, so the true AppendPath flags do not independently prove exact escaping behavior. Generator-addressability judgments are plausible opportunities or uncertainty, not verified support in the current generator.
